desc: OpenStack Compute (Nova) Folsom before 2012.2.2 and Grizzly, when using libvirt and LVM backed instances, does not properly clear physical volume (PV) content when reallocating for instances, which allows attackers to obtain sensitive information by reading the memory of the previous logical volume (LV).
desc_es: OpenStack Compute (Nova) Folsom antes de 2012.2.2 y Grizzly, cuando utiliza instancias con respaldo libvirt y LVM, no limpia adecuadamente el contenido del volumen físico  (PV) cuando se reasignan las instancias, lo que permite a los atacantes obtener información sensible mediante la lectura de la memoria de la anterior volumen lógico (LV).

desc: A flaw was found in OpenStack Keystone. This vulnerability allows remote authenticated users to bypass intended authorization restrictions. This occurs because OpenStack Keystone does not properly handle EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud) tokens when a user's role has been removed from a tenant. An attacker can leverage a token associated with a removed user role to gain unauthorized access.
desc_es: OpenStack Keystone Essex (2012.1) and Folsom (2012.2) no controlan correctamente los token EC2 cuando la función de usuario se ha eliminado de un inquilino, lo que permite a usuarios autenticados remotamente eludir las restricciones previstas al aprovechar un token para la función de usuario eliminado.
